description: This file contains CUDA-based spectral operations for PyTorch, including FFT plan management, execution, normalization, and support for various FFT transformations (R2C, C2R, C2C) with cuFFT integration.

classes.name: CuFFTConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for cuFFT plans, managing plan creation and execution parameters.

classes.name: CuFFTParamsLRUCache
classes.description: Cache for cuFFT plan parameters to optimize repeated FFT computations.

methods.name: exec_cufft_plan
methods.description: Executes a cuFFT plan with specified input/output data and direction.

methods.name: cufft_get_plan_cache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a plan cache for a specific CUDA device.

methods.name: cufft_get_plan_cache_max_size_impl
methods.description: Gets the maximum size of the cuFFT plan cache for a device.

methods.name: cufft_set_plan_cache_max_size_impl
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of the cuFFT plan cache for a device.

methods.name: cufft_get_plan_cache_size_impl
methods.description: Returns the current size of the plan cache for a device.

methods.name: cufft_clear_plan_cache_impl
methods.description: Clears the plan cache for a specific device.

methods.name: has_large_prime_factor
methods.description: Checks if a size has a large prime factor, influencing FFT algorithm choice.

methods.name: _exec_fft
methods.description: Performs an FFT operation (c2c, r2c, c2r) with plan caching and data permutation.

methods.name: _fft_normalization_scale
methods.description: Calculates normalization factor for FFT output.

methods.name: use_optimized_cufft_path
methods.description: Determines if optimized cuFFT path can be used based on transform dimensions.

methods.name: _fft_r2c_cufft
methods.description: Performs n-dimensional real-to-complex FFT using cuFFT.

methods.name: _fft_c2r_cufft
methods.description: Performs n-dimensional complex-to-real FFT using cuFFT.

methods.name: _fft_c2c_cufft
methods.description: Performs n-dimensional complex-to-complex FFT or IFFT using cuFFT.
